items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: I went all over here to Bugalooza and cut a ham with Isaiah Morgan.

ctx.x: Okay, it's going again. Okay, sometimes just nothing at all. That's right. I mean, you go play for a dance.

I mean, you, you, the, guy come get you and say we got a dance at you, such a place. Well, you go ahead on. You go there and people, the customers don't show up as they was, uh, expected. You want to call out a ham. Yeah, that's right. You would cut a ham. Take a ham. Uh-huh. I went all over here to Bugalooza and cut a ham with Isaiah Morgan. But that wasn't no ham. It was a mistake on Isaiah part. We was a week ahead of time. That's true. We left here to go to Bugalooza with Isaiah and got over to the place and…
Why did you call it cut a ham? Cut a ham?
